summary: @ecg-internal/adobe-dmp-js postinstall beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package declares a postinstall script `node beacon.cjs` and also triggers the same beacon from `index.js` on require. On install and on import, beacon.cjs POSTs the installer's hostname, install path, current working directory, and node version to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. The destination is not associated with any package publisher or Adobe infrastructure and uses a non-standard port. The package's `index.js` exports a Proxy whose properties are all no-ops and provides no functionality matching the name `@ecg-internal/adobe-dmp-js`; the only runtime behavior of the package is the host-identification beacon. The scoped internal-looking name (`@ecg-internal/*`) combined with a hollow stub and an install-time call-home to a bare-IP collector matches a dependency-confusion / internal-name-squat reconnaissance package used to confirm reach into a target build environment.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
